records.jp: こころって、田植えとか稲刈りとかしたことある？
records.en_original: Kokoro, have you ever planted or harvested rice?
records.en_auxiliary: Kokoro, have you ever planted or harvested rice?
records.en: Kokoro, have you ever planted or harvested rice?

records.jp: うん。ご近所さんのお手伝いで、<CR>収穫のお手伝いとかしたことはあるよ
records.en_original: Yes, I used to help my neighbors with their fields during harvest season.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes, I used to help my neighbors with their fields during harvest season.
records.en: Yes, I used to help my neighbors<CR>with their fields during harvest season.

records.jp: 田植えって大変そうだよね。<CR>長時間あんな姿勢でいたら腰が痛くなりそう……
records.en_original: It looks pretty tough. Doesn't your back hurt after leaning over all day?
records.en_auxiliary: It looks pretty tough. Doesn't your back hurt after leaning over all day?
records.en: It looks pretty tough.<CR>Doesn't your back hurt after leaning over all day?

records.jp: え……。<CR>愛央ちゃん、もしかして手で全部植えてると思ってる？
records.en_original: Uh... Ao, did you think that rice is all planted by hand?
records.en_auxiliary: Uh... Ao, did you think that rice is all planted by hand?
records.en: Uh...<CR>Ao-chan, did you think that rice is all planted by hand?

records.jp: え、違うの！？　田植えのイメージって、<CR>笠被った人が中腰で植えてる感じなんだけど……
records.en_original: Wait, it's not?! My image is like, older people bent over, planting those seedlings.
records.en_auxiliary: Wait, it's not?! My image is like, older people bent over, planting those seedlings.
records.en: Wait, it's not?! My image is like,<CR>older people bent over, planting those seedlings.

records.jp: 今はだいたい機械でやっちゃうから。<CR>お祭りとかで、昔の田植えを再現することはあるけど
records.en_original: Nowadays, it's all done by machines. The only times people do it by hand is for festivals or special occasions.
records.en_auxiliary: Nowadays, it's all done by machines. The only times people do it by hand is for festivals or special occasions.
records.en: Nowadays, it is mostly done by machine.<CR>Sometimes festivals recreate old-fashioned rice planting, though.

records.jp: そ、そうなんだ……
records.en_original: Huh, is that right...
records.en_auxiliary: Huh, is that right...
records.en: Huh, is that right...

records.jp: それを差し引いても大変なのは間違いないけどね
records.en_original: That being said, it's still a tough job.
records.en_auxiliary: That being said, it's still a tough job.
records.en: That being said, it's still a tough job.

records.jp: あと、ここには機械なんてないから、<CR>結局手作業でやるしかないね
records.en_original: And since we don't have a planter here, we have to do it by hand anyway.
records.en_auxiliary: And since we don't have a planter here, we have to do it by hand anyway.
records.en: And since we don't have a planter here,<CR>we have to do it by hand anyway.

records.jp: たんぼにダイブして泥んこになったりした？
records.en_original: Have you ever dove into the rice fields?
records.en_auxiliary: Have you ever dove into the rice fields?
records.en: Have you ever dove into the rice fields?

records.jp: ほら、テレビとかでよくアナウンサーの人が<CR>突っ込んだりしてるじゃん
records.en_original: You know, like in those TV shows where the host just jumps in and comes out all muddy?
records.en_auxiliary: You know, like in those TV shows where the host just jumps in and comes out all muddy?
records.en: You know, like in those TV shows where the host just<CR>jumps in and comes out all muddy?

records.jp: あれってそういうイベントなんじゃない？<CR>自分から突っ込んだりしたことはないかなあ
records.en_original: That's just to get a laugh though, right? I've never dove in on purpose.
records.en_auxiliary: That's just to get a laugh though, right? I've never dove in on purpose.
records.en: Is that not something they do specifically for those programs?<CR>I have never jumped in on purpose.

records.jp: 自分から……じゃあ、事故でやっちゃったことは？
records.en_original: On purpose? So you did on accident?
records.en_auxiliary: On purpose? So you did on accident?
records.en: On purpose? So you did on accident?

records.jp: それは……。あったかも。いや、うん。あった
records.en_original: Um, well, I... Yes...
records.en_auxiliary: Um, well, I... Yes...
records.en: Um, well, I... Yes...

records.jp: ふふ、ドジっ子こころだ
records.en_original: Hehe. You can be a little clumsy.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe. You can be a little clumsy.
records.en: Hehe. You can be a little clumsy.

records.jp: むー。愛央ちゃんも最初のうちはきっとそうなるよ
records.en_original: Mrg... I'm sure it'll happen to you once or twice too, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: Mrg... I'm sure it'll happen to you once or twice too, Ao.
records.en: Mrg... I'm sure it'll happen to you once or twice too, Ao-chan.

records.jp: ふーん？
records.en_original: Oh, really?
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, really?
records.en: Oh, really?

records.jp: んじゃあ、試しに私も田植えやってみようかな？
records.en_original: Well, let's give it a go then!
records.en_auxiliary: Well, let's give it a go then!
records.en: Well, let's give it a go then!

records.jp: ……うわっ！　めっちゃぬかるんでる！
records.en_original: Whoa! It's muddier in here than I thought!
records.en_auxiliary: Whoa! It's muddier in here than I thought!
records.en: Whoa! It's muddier in here than I thought!

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん大丈夫ー？
records.en_original: Are you alright, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: Are you alright, Ao?
records.en: Are you alright, Ao-chan?

records.jp: だ、だいじょう……うわあっ！
records.en_original: Y-yep— Wahh!
records.en_auxiliary: Y-yep— Wahh!
records.en: Y-yep— Wahh!

records.jp: あちゃー……
records.en_original: Oh dear...
records.en_auxiliary: Oh dear...
records.en: Oh dear...

records.jp: （ぬかるんでるせいで、起き上がりにく……）
records.en_original: (It's so muddy, I can barely get up...)
records.en_auxiliary: (It's so muddy, I can barely get up...)
records.en: (The mud makes it so hard to get back up...)

records.jp: んー……ふんっ！
records.en_original: Hrng... Hah!
records.en_auxiliary: Hrng... Hah!
records.en: Hrng... Hah!

records.jp: よし、復活……うわあっ！
records.en_original: Alright, I'm back u— Ahh!
records.en_auxiliary: Alright, I'm back u— Ahh!
records.en: Alright, I'm back u— Ahh!

records.jp: いったー……
records.en_original: Oww...
records.en_auxiliary: Oww...
records.en: Oww...

records.jp: あはは。ほら愛央ちゃん、手貸して
records.en_original: Hahaha! Here, Ao. Give me your hand.
records.en_auxiliary: Hahaha! Here, Ao. Give me your hand.
records.en: Hahaha! Here, Ao-chan. Give me your hand.

records.jp: こころー……手ぇ貸してー……
records.en_original: Kokorooo... Help meee...
records.en_auxiliary: Kokorooo... Help meee...
records.en: Kokorooo... Help meee...

records.jp: もう、しょうがないなあ、愛央ちゃんは
records.en_original: Oh, Ao. You're helpless without me.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, Ao. You're helpless without me.
records.en: Oh, Ao-chan. You're helpless without me.

records.jp: うんしょっと……
records.en_original: Here we...go.
records.en_auxiliary: Here we...go.
records.en: Here we...go.

records.jp: あー……収穫されるお米の気分……
records.en_original: Ahh... Looks like the harvester becomes the hearvestee.
records.en_auxiliary: Ahh... Looks like the harvester becomes the hearvestee.
records.en: Ah... I feel like rice being harvested...

records.jp: 冗談言ってるとまた転んじゃうよ
records.en_original: Stop joking around or you'll fall in again.
records.en_auxiliary: Stop joking around or you'll fall in again.
records.en: Stop joking around or you'll fall in again.

records.jp: はー……。ひどい目にあった。<CR>たんぼ、恐るべし
records.en_original: *Sigh*... That was terrible. Rice fields are pretty dangerous, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: *Sigh*... That was terrible. Rice fields are pretty dangerous, huh?
records.en: *Sigh*... That was terrible. Rice fields are<CR>pretty dangerous, huh?

records.jp: 次からは気を付けてね
records.en_original: Be careful next time, okay?
records.en_auxiliary: Be careful next time, okay?
records.en: Be careful next time, okay?

records.jp: うん。助けてくれてありがとね、こころ
records.en_original: I will. Thanks for the help.
records.en_auxiliary: I will. Thanks for the help.
records.en: I will. Thanks for the help.

records.jp: ……それにしても、まさか自分たちで<CR>お米を育てることになるとは……
records.en_original: But boy, I never imagined we'd have to make our own rice.
records.en_auxiliary: But boy, I never imagined we'd have to make our own rice.
records.en: But boy, I never imagined we'd<CR>have to make our own rice.

records.jp: お米は大事だよ。<CR>豊かな食生活のためには、絶対必要
records.en_original: Rice is a must. It's an important part of a balanced diet.
records.en_auxiliary: Rice is a must. It's an important part of a balanced diet.
records.en: Rice is a must.<CR>It's an important part of a balanced diet.

records.jp: なんか……いつになくやる気だよね、こころ
records.en_original: You always get worked up about this kind of stuff, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: You always get worked up about this kind of stuff, huh?
records.en: You always get worked up about this kind of stuff, huh?

records.jp: だって、お米だよ。全ての食の基本。<CR>お米がない生活なんて考えられないよ
records.en_original: Well, it's rice! Our whole diet is built around it. I can't think of life without rice.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, it's rice! Our whole diet is built around it. I can't think of life without rice.
records.en: But it is rice. The foundation of all food.<CR>I cannot imagine a life without rice.

records.jp: うんうん。わかるわかる。<CR>ご飯があるからこそ、他のおかずも輝くんだよね
records.en_original: Totally. Everything tastes better with a nice bowl of rice.
records.en_auxiliary: Totally. Everything tastes better with a nice bowl of rice.
records.en: Totally. Everything<CR>tastes better with a nice bowl of rice.

records.jp: さすが愛央ちゃん、わかってる！
records.en_original: I couldn't have said it any better, Ao!
records.en_auxiliary: I couldn't have said it any better, Ao!
records.en: I couldn't have said it any better, Ao-chan!

records.jp: こころのためにも、頑張らないとね
records.en_original: I'll have to work hard so you can get the rice you love so much!
records.en_auxiliary: I'll have to work hard so you can get the rice you love so much!
records.en: I'll have to work hard so you can get the rice you love so much!

records.jp: わたしだけじゃないよ。みんなのために、ね
records.en_original: Not just for me. For everyone, right?
records.en_auxiliary: Not just for me. For everyone, right?
records.en: Not just for me. For everyone, right?

records.jp: そ、そこまでかなあ……。<CR>パンとか麺も大事……だよ？
records.en_original: Er, but is it that important? I mean, there's bread and pasta... Those are good too.
records.en_auxiliary: Er, but is it that important? I mean, there's bread and pasta... Those are good too.
records.en: I-is it really that serious...?<CR>Bread and noodles are important too... you know?

records.jp: それはわかってるんだけど……。<CR>でも、お米はやっぱり特別なの……です
records.en_original: I know, but... Rice is just, I don't know, special.
records.en_auxiliary: I know, but... Rice is just, I don't know, special.
records.en: I understand that...<CR>But rice really is special... it is.

records.jp: ……あはははは！
records.en_original: Hahaha!
records.en_auxiliary: Hahaha!
records.en: Hahaha!

records.jp: ど、どうして笑うの……？
records.en_original: D-did I say something funny?
records.en_auxiliary: D-did I say something funny?
records.en: D-did I say something funny?

records.jp: いやー、こころがそこまで頑なになるところって<CR>普段見ないからさ。珍しいもん見たなーって
records.en_original: I just don't get to see you get so passionate very often.
records.en_auxiliary: I just don't get to see you get so passionate very often.
records.en: I just don't get to see you get<CR>so passionate very often.

records.jp: むー……わたしは真剣なのに
records.en_original: Mrg... I was being serious.
records.en_auxiliary: Mrg... I was being serious.
records.en: Mrg... I was being serious.

records.jp: ごめんごめん。<CR>こころのために私も頑張るよ！
records.en_original: Sorry, sorry. Don't worry, I'll keep doing my best.
records.en_auxiliary: Sorry, sorry. Don't worry, I'll keep doing my best.
records.en: Sorry, sorry.<CR>Don't worry, I'll keep doing my best.

records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
